scope: Complete missing language editions of published series; preserve existing complete primary editions.
inventory_limit: Route coverage is not a quality score. Older English/Traditional JavaScript reading modes need manual verification before being called missing. Unlisted legacy URLs and unpublished originals are excluded.
policy: Use the Chinese essay, not the academic paper or an abbreviated foreign edition, as the editorial source.
Prefer the author's supplied multilingual manuscripts when available; review against the current source before use.
Keep every argument, example, qualification and open question; do not substitute summaries for complete editions.
Source-unit alignment is only a structural check. Reject outline-like or compressed prose even when every unit is present; rewrite from the Chinese source before review.
Freeze language drafts or small internal batches before independent full-prose review. Authors must not silently change frozen sections while another editor reviews them.
Do not overwrite Simplified/Traditional Chinese or English merely because a received package contains replacements.
Each series requires full reading, editorial corrections, navigation/metadata/search/analytics checks, and a local commit.
Commit each completed series separately. The author will push; never push automatically.
